definitions.explanation: To discuss a matter in a formal, institutional setting — typically in a legislature, board meeting, or committee — with a view to reaching a decision. Restricted to written and formal contexts; replaced in everyday speech by {議論|ぎろん}する or {話|はな}し{合|あ}う.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する。
⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する。
examples.english: The bill is deliberated in committee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: In the Diet, a special committee was set up to deliberate on this issue.

notes:
A literary, formal suru verb built on the single kanji {議|ぎ} ('discussion; deliberation'), the same element seen in ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧, ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧, and ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧. Used almost exclusively in written reports, legal texts, and news coverage of legislative proceedings; virtually never appears in conversation.

USAGE:
- Takes a direct object marked by ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, typically a topic, bill, or agenda item: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する ('to deliberate on a bill').
- The more common everyday equivalent is ⟦{議論|ぎろん}する→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧; for informal group discussion, use ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧.
- Often appears in the passive {議|ぎ}される when the subject is the topic being deliberated: {議|ぎ}される⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ ('the content to be deliberated').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する: to deliberate on a bill
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する: to deliberate on the budget
- ⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する: to take up an agenda item
- ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{議|ぎ}する: to deliberate on policy
- ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{議|ぎ}する: to deliberate in committee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}する→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧: to discuss; to argue — the normal everyday term; covers both formal discussion and informal argument.
- ⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confer; to consult together — emphasizes joint consultation, often between organizations or parties.
- ⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliberate (on a bill) — near-synonym, especially common for legislative bills; often interchangeable with {議|ぎ}する.
- {評議|ひょうぎ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliberate in council — used for formal councils and judicial deliberations.
